declaration_rule: If more than one of GRAPH, FINITE_ALGEBRA_EQUATIONAL, and AUTOMATA_GAME_PROCESS fires, classify as ambiguous.
An explicit finite signal may occur in the declaration header or elsewhere in the same source module, to cover section variables without reading semantics.
A GRAPH declaration plus an explicit finite signal with an ordered-relation token is GRAPH_SCALAR_INEQUALITY; graph declarations without an explicit finite signal are excluded.
A GRAPH declaration plus an explicit finite signal without an ordered-relation token is GRAPH_STRUCTURAL_PROPERTY.
A sole algebra signal plus an explicit finite signal is FINITE_ALGEBRA_EQUATIONAL; otherwise exclude.
A sole automata/game/process path or header signal is AUTOMATA_GAME_PROCESS. This stratum is defined by the frozen process-family syntax/path vocabulary rather than a generic finite token.
With no specialized signal but an explicit finite signal, use FINITE_COMBINATORIAL. Otherwise exclude as unclassified. This is a sampling label, not a claim about mathematical ontology.

cluster_rule.eligible_only_if: all open declarations in the module receive the same non-ambiguous stratum
cluster_rule.cross_module_sibling_ambiguity: exclude during the contamination/identity gate; never split after randomness
